scenario: Discussing a news story with a colleague
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Na contexte ya ba oyo, ezali kozonga etalela to rapɔ́to.
Ezali kozongaka kozala na sujet to problème.
Motoya oyo ezali kobatela molongo mpo na kosala concession.
Résultat to impact ya noko.
Verbe oyo ezali koloba elukaka.
Groupe ya ba autorités oyo bazali kosala pays.
Relatif na population to gouvernement (te privé).
Adverbe oyo ezali koloba probabilité.
Kobondela décision.
Ezali koloba opposition.
Motoya oyo ezali kobatela molongo mpo na kosala concession.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you see the report about the new public transport plan?
dialogue.translation: Oyaki rapɔ́to oyo ya liboso ya plan ya transport ya public?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I read it. Although the government says it will help, many people are against it.
dialogue.translation: Eh, nakitani. Kasi gouvernement alobi ete bakokende, ba oyo mingi bazali kontra.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the main issue is the cost. It might increase taxes, and that could have a big effect on the economy.
dialogue.translation: Nakokoka koloba ete problème ya liboso ezali coût. Elukaka impôts, mpe yango ekoki kosala effet ya sika na économie.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Probably, but they say it will create more jobs. I'm not sure what they will decide.
dialogue.translation: Probablement, kasi bazali koloba ete ekokende na bosango ya misala mingi. Nazali na botosi te oyo bakobondela.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but if they cut other services, it will be a problem. The public might be more affected than they think.
dialogue.translation: Eh, kasi soki bazali kopesa ba services noko, ekokende na problème. Public ekoki kozala na effet mingi koleka oyo bazali kokoka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's wait and see. Although I'm a bit worried, I hope they make a good choice.
dialogue.translation: Tokola kozela mpe tokota. Kasi nazali na mawa moke, nazali koluka ete bakosala choix ya malamu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, we can only hope. I'll check the news again tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Eh, tokoki koluka mpenza. Nakotindela yango liboso na biloko ya sika na lusadisu.

scenario: Negotiating a minor disagreement
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ezali na kozonga ndenge toli okoki kosalema na mposa moko to likambo moko.
Ekoma na nzela ya nsuka ya motuna oyo ezali na ntina ya kobatela mposa moko.
Ezali na ntina ya kozonga ete likambo moko ekoki kozala to ndenge moko.
Ezali na ntina ya kozonga alternative moko na esika ya oyo ezali kozongama.
Mibeko to strategie oyo tozali kosalela likambo moko.
Kobimisa likambo moko to kosalela ndenge moko.
Ezali na ntina ya kozonga likambo moko to mposa moko.
Ezali na ntina ya kozonga bosembo to kozonga ete tozali na mposa moko.
Ezali na ntina ya kozonga ete likambo moko ekoki kozala, ezali na ndenge moko na 'maybe'.
Ezali na ntina ya kozonga ete likambo moko ezali te.
Ezali na ntina ya kozonga mposa moko oyo ezali na kontra na oyo ezali kozongama liboso.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I don't agree with your plan to go to the beach, though.
dialogue.translation: Nazali kobima te na mibeko na yo ya kokende na plajie, kasi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe we could change the time instead of changing the place.
dialogue.translation: Mbala mosusu tokoki kobimisa hora na esika ya kobimisa esika.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I'm not sure it's the best matter to discuss right now.
dialogue.translation: Ezali mposa malamu, kasi nazali na bosembo te ete ezali likambo malamu ya kozonga yango mosika.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perhaps we should just decide together without arguing.
dialogue.translation: Mbala mosusu tokoki kosala décision mobimba ntoko tozali na kozanga kozanga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree, but I still think the plan has a problem, though.
dialogue.translation: Nazali kobima, kasi nazali kozanga ete mibeko ezali na problème, kasi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe we can try a different plan, perhaps a picnic instead?
dialogue.translation: Mbala mosusu tokoki kosala mibeko mosusu, mbala mosusu picnic na esika?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, that could work without any problem. Let's do that, though.
dialogue.translation: Na bosembo, ezali kokoka kosala ntoko tozali na kozanga kozanga. Tosala yango, kasi.

scenario: Giving feedback on someone's work
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ezali na kosalela ete likambo moko ekomi kosalema te yango líwa.
Ekɔmɔlɔmbwisi ete ezali mbeka moko. Boye: 'though' ezali na ntina ya kobimisa, kasi tozali kosalela yango kaka na mbeka oyo esili kolandela.
Ekɔmɔlɔmbwisi motoya ya ekelame ya likambo moko.
Ekɔmɔlɔmbwisi bosɔmɛlɛ ya kopesa nguya to kozonga bosɔmɛlɛ ya motuya to bosaleli.
Kobongisa to kozonga likambo moko.
Likambo oyo ekomi na ntina ya bosaleli moko.
Ezali na kosalela ete mbeka moko ekɔmɔlɔmbwisi mbeka moko oyo esili kolandela.
Kokanisa likambo moko ntango olingi kobɔnda bosaleli.
Likambo oyo ekoki kosalema to kozala.
Kopesa to kosala likambo moko oyo ezali na nguya.
Kobatela to kokɔmbatela moto to likambo moko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I’ve read your draft, but I haven’t finished the last section yet.
dialogue.translation: Nakomi koyoka esika ozali kosala, kasi nakomi kosala mbala mosusu te.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That’s okay. The quality of the beginning is quite good, I think.
dialogue.translation: Ezali malamu. Motoya ya mbongo ezali malamu mingi, nakoki koloba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree with that, though we need to improve the ending a lot.
dialogue.translation: Nazali koyoka ete ezali malamu, kasi tozali na kozonga mbala mosusu mingi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, the result is not strong enough. However, your ideas are clear.
dialogue.translation: Eh, likambo oyo ekomi na ntina ezali mibe te. Kasi, mikapo na yo ezali ya semba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks. What else should I consider for the final version?
dialogue.translation: Merci. Nasingi koyeba likambo moko mosusu nazali na koyeba ntango nazali kosala mbala mosusu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It’s possible to add more examples, and provide more evidence for your claims.
dialogue.translation: Ekoki kozonga mikapo mingi, mpe kopesa bilili mingi na mikapo na yo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I’ll work on that. Can you support me with the data?
dialogue.translation: Malamu, nazali kosala yango. Oyoki kobatela ngai na bilili?

key_phrases.translation: Nasingi koyeba likambo moko mosusu nazali na koyeba?

scenario: Explaining a problem to customer service
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I received my order yesterday, but the color is wrong.
dialogue.translation: Mbote, nakíaki komanda na ngai liboso, kasi mónga ezali malámu te.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you send me a photo of the item you received?
dialogue.translation: Nazali kolánda kozonga mpo na yango. Boye ozali kosánda na ngai foto ya motuya oyo okíaki?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll send it right away. Also, I need to return the item and get a refund.
dialogue.translation: Eh, nakosánda yango mosíka. Lokola náti, nazali na bosungi ya kosenga motuya mpe kopona koséksa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. We will not charge you for the return. Please check your email for instructions.
dialogue.translation: Ya 솔로. Tokobokobá yo te mpo na kosenga. Tola email na yo mpo na boyambi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. How long will I have to wait for the refund?
dialogue.translation: Merci. Nákoti nákoka tánga mpo na koséksa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Usually it takes 5–7 days. Please be careful with the return label we provide.
dialogue.translation: Na bosɔtɔ, ezali kotánga 5–7 floor. Boye  ya motoya na etikɛta ya kosenga oyo tozali kopesa yo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I'll be careful. Thank you for solving my problem.
dialogue.translation: Malamu, nakokanga motoya. Merci mpo na kosilisa problème na ngai.

scenario: Talking about ambitions and career goals
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ezali na kozonga mpo na likanisi to goals, mbala moke koleka 'get'.
Ezali kozonga mpo na mbongo ya mobali, kasi si 'carrera universitaria'.
Ezali sé na lisálisi, kasi ezali kozonga mpo na kopesa na kopesa.
Mbala moke ezali 'conducir a'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want to achieve a high position in my career, but I know it will require a lot of effort.
dialogue.translation: Nakoti kóma poste mwa mpenza na lifelo na ngai, kasi nayebi ete nde kozala na bosembo mpenza.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a great goal. What kind of role would you like to reach in the future?
dialogue.translation: Ezali likanisi mpenza. Naki role olingi kopesa na mbongo na yo na zomi?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd love to lead a team someday, but I think I need more experience first.
dialogue.translation: Nakoti kotambola equipe mobimba, kasi nayebi ete nazali na bosembo mpenza na kati.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe you can find an opportunity to manage a small project at work.
dialogue.translation: Mbala moke ozali kozala na zosali ya kotambola projet moke na mosala.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope so. Success doesn't come overnight, so I'll continue studying and improving my skills.
dialogue.translation: Nazali koluka yango. Bosembo ezali kozala te, kasi nazali kolanda yango na kosala na kosala.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's the right attitude. I'm sure you'll achieve everything you set your mind to.
dialogue.translation: Ezali attitude mpenza. Nazali na bosembo ete ozali kóma nyonso olingi.

scenario: Discussing health habits and lifestyle

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I try to exercise in the morning, but I don't do it often.
dialogue.translation: Nakɔtɛ́laka kosala sport na lɛlɔ́, kasi nalɛ́salaka yango mpenza te.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's okay. The important thing is to listen to your body and find a routine that works for you.
dialogue.translation: Ezali malamu. Mokolo mɔ́tɔ ezali kosɛnga mpo na kosɛnga mɔ́tɔ na kozala na nzɔ́ngɔ ya kozala malamu mpo na yo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I know. I feel much better when I have more energy during the day.
dialogue.translation: Nazali koyeba. Nazali kolinga malamu mpenza soki nazali na nguya mpenza na mokolo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, and sleep is a key part of that. Do you sleep at least seven hours?
dialogue.translation: Eh, na kosala ezali mɔ́tɔ kɔlɔ́mɔ mpo na yango. Oyɛlaka ndakisa ya awa mawa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Usually, yes. But my main problem is stress, not sleep.
dialogue.translation: Na ndakisa, eh. Kasi mɛ́la na ngai ezali mpe ya kozala na ntɔ́ngɔ te.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Stress can affect your health a lot. Maybe you need a new habit to relax, like reading or walking.
dialogue.translation: Mpe ya kozala na ntɔ́ngɔ ekɔ́i mpenza mpo na nzɔ́ngɔ na yo. Mbala mosúsu ozali na nzɔ́ngɔ ya kozala na bilɔ́ngɔ mpo na kopɛsa, lokola kotanga to kokɛnda.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, because I want to feel healthier overall.
dialogue.translation: Ezali molɔngɔ́ ya malamu, mpo na nazali kolinga kolinga malamu mpenza na ntɔ́ngɔ na ngai nyonso.

key_phrases.translation: kosɛnga mɔ́tɔ na kozala na nzɔ́ngɔ

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How was your trip to the mountains last weekend?
dialogue.translation: Ndenge nini ezali mbóka na bato oyo bazongaki na mikili esika esili?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It was quite wonderful, but we arrived later than we expected because of the traffic.
dialogue.translation: Ezali malamu mingi, kasi tokaki na likambo ya kozonga na mbóka moko na moko na ntina ya likambo ya kozonga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you stay in a hotel or in a cabin?
dialogue.translation: Ozali kolala na ndako moko to na ndako moko?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We stayed in a small cabin with an amazing view of the lake.
dialogue.translation: Tokaki na ndako moko na mbongo malamu ya mwasi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Although the weather was cloudy, did you still enjoy the experience?
dialogue.translation: Kasi ntango ezali na likambo ya kozonga, ozali na mokano malamu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we decided to go hiking, and we had a wonderful time, however, the trail was quite steep.
dialogue.translation: Eh, tokaki na mokano malamu, kasi ezali na likambo ya kozonga, ezali malamu mingi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'm glad you had such a good time. I love to travel to new places too.
dialogue.translation: Nazali na komeka na mokano malamu. Nazali na kozonga na ndako moko.

key_phrases.translation: Ndenge nini ezali mbóka na bato oyo bazongaki?

Ezali kozonga ete oyo mɔkɔlɔ ekɔmɔ liboso na ntɔngɔ, mbala nyingi ya mabe.
Ezali kozonga ete oyo mɔkɔlɔ ekɔmɔ liboso na ntɔngɔ, mbala nyingi ya mabe.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think plastic waste is a serious problem, but people still use too much of it.
dialogue.translation: Nakoki koloba ete mɔkɔ ya plastik ezali mɔkɔ mabe, kasi bato kaka basali yango mingi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.yes: I know. A common mistake is using single plastic bags for everything.
dialogue.translation: Nazali koyeba. Mɔkɔ mɔ̌kɔ ezali kosala mosala mɔ̌kɔ na plastik mɔ̌kɔ na nyonso.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. That habit can cause a lot of damage to the environment over time.
dialogue.translation: Kaka oyo. Mosala yango ekoki kobɔkɔla mɔkɔ mingi na ndɔtɔ ya mbotama na ntɔngɔ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what is the best action we can take to reduce our impact?
dialogue.translation: Lelo, nini ezali mɛlɔ ya mɛlɔ oyo tokoki kosala pona komɛlɛlɛ ntɔngɔ na biso?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, using a reusable bottle is a simple step. And it's likely to become a habit quickly.
dialogue.translation: Eh, kosala botɛlɛ oyo ekoki kosalema ezali mɛlɔ ya mɛlɔ. Na yango ekoki kosala mosala ya solo na bosɔmeni.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That makes sense. I'm not against small changes, though. Every little bit helps.
dialogue.translation: Oyo ezali na ntɔngɔ. Nazali kɔtɔ banganganɛ, kasi. Nyonso ekoki kosala.

scenario: Discussing a decision you had to make
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Verbo ezali na ngonga moke: choose, chose, chosen.
Nom na kopí.
Motoya ya 'choice'.
Na contexte ya décision, eleki koluka biloko oyo ezali malamu mpe oyo ezali mabe.
Ezali kobimisa résultat ya mobu ya décision.
Ezali kobunda ndenge ya nom mpe verbe.
Ekoma kobimisa sécurité mpe oyo ezali spécifique kasi ezali na detaye te.
Ezali kosalema bosungi ya mobu mpe ya décision.
Ezali kosalema préférence.
Ekoma kosalema concession.
Ekoma kobimisa cause.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I had to choose between two job offers last week.
dialogue.translation: Nazali kosenga mpo na kosenga moko na ba offre ya travail mobimba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a tough decision. What options did you weigh?
dialogue.translation: Ezali décision mabe. Naki option oyo ozali kopesa poids?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I considered the salary and the commute, but the risk of moving to a new city was a big factor.
dialogue.translation: Nakokani salaire mpe déplacement, kasi risque ya kobimisa na ville moko ezali facteur ya ntina.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Were you certain about the outcome of each option?
dialogue.translation: Ozali sûr na sujet ya résultat ya chaque option?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Not fully, although I knew the salary was higher in the second job.
dialogue.translation: Te na ndenge nionso, bien que nazali koyeba salaire ezali ya ntina na travail ya zomi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what did you finally decide?
dialogue.translation: Kasi, naki ozali kosala décision ya mobu?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I chose the first job, rather than the second, due to the shorter commute and better work-life balance.
dialogue.translation: Nazali kosenga travail ya liboso, plutôt que ya zomi, à cause de déplacement ya kokufa mpe équilibre ya travail-vie ya malamu.

scenario: Explaining why you changed your mind

Esalamu mpo na kokoma yango na elongo ya malamu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've changed my mind about the trip to the beach this weekend.
dialogue.translation: Nakobongaki mposa na esika ya kozala na plajɛ na week-end oyo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Really? Why? You seemed so excited about it before.
dialogue.translation: Na bosɔtɔ? Mpo na nini? Ozalaki na mposa mingi mpo na yango liboso.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, I realized that the weather forecast is bad, and actually, I have a lot of work to do.
dialogue.translation: Eh, nabakeli ete mokano ya lɛlɔ ezali mabe, mpe na bosɔtɔ, nazali na misala mingi mpo na kosala.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But you had a plan to relax and enjoy the sun!
dialogue.translation: Kasi ozali na molango mpo na koposa mpe kobanga sole!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but I realized that it's not possible to finish my project if I go. Since the deadline is Monday, I need to stay home.
dialogue.translation: Eh, kasi nabakeli ete ezali na nguya te mpo na kosala mosala na ngai soki nazali koya. Mpo ete mokolo ya kosala ezali Luni, nazali na mposa mpo na kosala na esika na ngai.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a fact. But you could work in the morning and go later, instead of canceling everything.
dialogue.translation: Ezali mokano. Kasi ozali kosala na basawa mpe koyebisa na mbula, kasi te mpo na kobimisa nyonso.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, though I need to see if my friend can support me with the ride. Thanks for the advice!
dialogue.translation: Ezali molango malamu, kasi nazali na mposa mpo na mona soki moninga na ngai azali kosala na ngai na esika ya kopesa. Matondo mpo na elongo!

scenario: Talking about cultural differences

dialogue.translation: Nazali koyeba ete ezali mɔ́tɔ oyo ezali na ndakisa ya mambu oyo basali na bato mɔ́tɔ kati na biso.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, even something like greeting can be a custom that changes the behavior of people.
dialogue.translation: Eh, ata mɔ́tɔ oyo ezali na kombo ya kozonga ezali kobimisa kombo ya bato.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: For example, in my culture, it's rude to eat with your hands, but in some places it's completely polite.
dialogue.translation: Na ndakisa, na cultura na ngai, ezali mibei kolia na mikɔlɔ, kasi na bangomba mosusu ezali malamu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I usually expect people to follow local customs, but I try to respect different ones.
dialogue.translation: Nazali malamu kɛlɛ́ bato basala kombo ya mboka, kasi nazali kosɛnga koluka bangomba mosusu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's good. I think many customs are similar in essence, just expressed differently.
dialogue.translation: Ezali malamu. Nazali koyeba ete kombo mingi ezali mɔ́tɔ na makasi, kasi ezali kosalema na ndenge mɔ́tɔ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, the key is to be open and learn about the differences between us.
dialogue.translation: Lelo, mokolo ezali ya kozonga na koyeba mambu oyo ezali kati na biso.

scenario: Discussing technology in daily life

vocabulary.note: Kozala na bosɛli ya kobɔnda makasi to bandako mabɔkɔ.
Mɔtɔndo ya elektrɔnikɛ kɔti telephɔnɛ to tabletɛ.
Mɔsɛka oyo esalemi likolɔ ya yango.
Prɔgrɑmɛ oyo ekomami na telephɔnɛ.
Kɔmɔna to kosɛnga mbɔkɔ na nɛmbɔ.
Kɔtɔla na bosɛli ya internet.
Mɔsɛka ya nguya ya mɔtɔndo.
Mɔtɔ ya yambo to kɔmɔnikasɔ̃ mɔkɔlɛ.
Kɔta yango mɔtɔndo na bosɛli ya internet.
Mɔndɔ oyo azali kosɛnga nɛmbɔ, kasi na teknɔlɔgi.
Mɔkɔlɛ ya kosala to koyeba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to connect my new phone to the Wi-Fi, but I can't find the settings.
dialogue.translation: Nazali na nguya ya kobɔnda telephɔnɛ ya ngaï na Wi-Fi, kasi nazali kobɛta makasi te.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's simple. Just go to the settings app and look for the Wi-Fi option.
dialogue.translation: Ezali bosɔkɔ. Kende na aplikasɔ̃ ya makasi mpe bɛta ɔptiyɔ̃ ya Wi-Fi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, I see. But I also want to download a new messenger app to message my friends.
dialogue.translation: Ah, nazali koyeba. Kasi nazali mpe na bongo ya kotelema aplikasɔ̃ mosɔ ya mɛsajɛ ya kobimisa baninga na ngai.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's useful, but check the battery first. Downloading can use a lot of energy.
dialogue.translation: Ezali malamu, kasi bɛta bateryɛ liboso. Kotelema ekoki kosɛnga nguya mingi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. And what about the screen? Sometimes it stays on too long.
dialogue.translation: Ozali na bosɔkɔ. Mpe ɛkrɛnɛ? Mbala mosɔ yango ekomi mpenza na likolɔ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You can change that in the settings, too. Also, as a user, you should share your location with friends only if you trust them.
dialogue.translation: Ozali kokoka kobɔngola yango na makasi, mpe. Mpe, lokola mozui, bosali sɔkɔ te soki ozali na botɔ na bango.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks! Now I feel more comfortable using my device online.
dialogue.translation: Merci! Kasi nazali na botɔ mpenza na kosɛnga mɔtɔndo na ngai na likolɔ.

scenario: At a formal meeting giving your opinion

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: In my view, the main issue is the budget for the project.
dialogue.translation: Na molɔngɔ́ na ngai, mbotama ya ntɔngɔ́ ezali mbongo mpo na proze.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see your point, however, I think we should consider the timeline first.
dialogue.translation: Nakoki mona molɔngɔ́ na yo, kasi, nakɔ́ngɔ ete tokoki kosɛnga ntango ya ntɔngɔ́ liboso.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That is a valid point. Therefore, perhaps we can discuss both together.
dialogue.translation: Ezali molɔngɔ́ oyo ezali malamu. Mpo na yango, mbala moko tokoki kosolola mibɛlɛ mibɛlɛ mpe mibɛlɛ mibɛlɛ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree with that. In addition, we could ask for more data from the team.
dialogue.translation: Nazali kokɔmɔngɔna na yango. Na likambo moko, tokoki kolinga bilili mingi na botiki.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea. According to the latest report, we have some flexibility.
dialogue.translation: Molɔngɔ́ malamu. Na mokɔlɔ ya rapɔ́ ya sokɔ, tokoki kosala mambu na bosɔkɔngɔ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I suggest we prepare a proposal with both options.
dialogue.translation: Liboso nalakisa ete tokosala bosɛ́li mpe mibɛlɛ mibɛlɛ.

key_phrases.translation: Na mokɔlɔ ya rapɔ́ ya sokɔ

scenario: Describing a person's character in depth

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I really admire my sister because she is always honest, even when it's difficult.
dialogue.translation: Nazali kolinga mingi ndeko na ngai boye ye azali ntango nyonso molángi, ata soki ezali mabe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's great. My best friend is very brave – he once stood up to a bully at school.
dialogue.translation: Ezali malamu. Nkenta na ngai azali mókolo mingi – ye apesaki bosembo na moto oyo azali kosala na ye na eskole.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wow, that takes courage. My sister is also generous and often helps our neighbors with their groceries.
dialogue.translation: Wawu, ezali na bosembo. Ndeko na ngai azali mpe mokolo na azali na bosembo na kosala bato oyo bazali na biso na bango na makasi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: She sounds kind. My friend is usually patient, but he can get into a bad mood if he's tired.
dialogue.translation: Ye azali molángi. Nkenta na ngai azali na bosembo, kasi azali kosala na mokili mabe soki azali na ntango.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. My sister is a bit shy at first, but once you know her, she's very friendly.
dialogue.translation: Nazali kosala. Ndeko na ngai azali na bosembo na bato oyo azali kosala na yango, kasi soki oyebi ye, ye azali molángi mingi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's nice. My friend has a great sense of humor – he always makes me laugh.
dialogue.translation: Ezali malamu. Nkenta na ngai azali na moyolo ya humor – ye azali ntango nyonso kopesa ngai bosembo.

scenario: Talking about education and learning

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to study more for my English course, but I don't have much time.
dialogue.translation: Nazali na mposa ya kobundisa mingi mpo na mbotama na ngai ya sayna, kasi nazali na ntalo mingi te.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Why don't you practice with me every evening? We can learn together.
dialogue.translation: Ndenge nini okobundisa te na ngai mobimba? Tokoki kobondela makasi pamba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I have a question: do you think our teacher will help us if we don't understand something?
dialogue.translation: Ezali mpenza mawa, kasi nazali na bosengi moko: oyebi ete moyekisi na biso akotusa biso soki tokomi na mayele te na noko moko?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course, our teacher always answers every question with a clear example.
dialogue.translation: Ya soló, moyekisi na biso akobimisa ntango nionso bosengi na biso na mokolo oyo ezali koyokisa yango lokuta.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope I can remember all the new words we learn.
dialogue.translation: Nazali kolandela ete nakoki kobatela nionso ya maye masusu oyo tozali kobondela.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: If you practice daily, you will see that you remember more easily.
dialogue.translation: Soki okobundisa mobimba, okoyoka ete okobatela mingi na bosengi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's start today, and I'll be a better student!
dialogue.translation: Ozali na yango. Tokoma kokwala yango lelo, na kozala mobundisi mawa!

scenario: Discussing a problem and offering solutions
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Bosalemi na 'problem'.
Mpo na kosala na 'find' to 'offer'.
Boye mpenza na likambo ya mibɛlɛ, kasi bosalemi awa na ntina mɔtɔndɔ : 'agree on' (kokɔta na).
Na ntina oyo eleki kobanga 'duro'.
Bosalemi mpo na kozaba makasi.
Ekɔmi na bosɔtɛ to kozonga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have a big problem with the schedule for next week.
dialogue.translation: Tokomi na problème mɔ́tɔ na programa ya mokolo ya liboso.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I know it's hard, but maybe we can find a solution together.
dialogue.translation: Nazali koyeba ete ezali mɔ́tɔ, kasi mbala mosusu tokoki kosilisa mosala mpe na bango.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd like to offer my idea: we could move the meeting to Friday.
dialogue.translation: Nakɔta mibeko ya mono : tokoki kobimisa mitungisi na vendéredi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds easy to do, but will everyone agree on the new time?
dialogue.translation: Ezali kozanga boye, kasi nani akɔta na l'heure ya sika?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Let's ask them first, and then we can decide what to do.
dialogue.translation: Tokɛlɛ bango liboso, simá tokoki komitisá nini tokosala.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good plan. Let's do that and solve this problem today.
dialogue.translation: Mɔtindɔ ya mɔ́tɔ. Tokosala yango mpe tokosila problème oyo lelo.

scenario: Comparing two options for a trip
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Mosaliyangwa koti okomisa ntalo mpo na kosenga likambo moko.
Verbo irregular: cost, cost, cost.
Ezali kozongisa ntango, kasi te bolingo ya makasi.
Mosaliyangwa koti okoma likambo na yo.
Comparativo ya moke.
Mosaliyangwa na makomami.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I can't decide which option to choose for our trip: the bus or the train.
dialogue.translation: Nakoki kosenga ntalo mpo na kosenga likambo mpo na esika na biso: bus to train.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, the bus is cheaper than the train, but it's slower.
dialogue.translation: Eh, bus ezali ya motoya kopesa train, kasi ezali ya mike.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the train costs more, and we need to arrive quickly.
dialogue.translation: Eh, kasi train ekotɛka moke, mpe to na mposa ya kozonga na makasi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Also, the train is safer, especially at night.
dialogue.translation: Kasi, train ezali ya seko, liboso na mawa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But the train is more expensive, and we can bring more luggage on the bus.
dialogue.translation: Kasi train ezali ya likolo, mpe tokoki koyela bagage moke na bus.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's true. So maybe we should take the bus and spend less money.
dialogue.translation: Ezali solo. Eh, tokoki koyeba bus mpe kobima moke.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's go with the bus. We can save money and still have fun.
dialogue.translation: Eh, tokoki koyeba bus. Tokoki kobima moke mpe kozala na nguya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How often do you usually post on social media?
dialogue.translation: Na bangomba nini ozali koboya malamu na mikanda ya mosala?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I try to share something every day, but sometimes I just scroll through my feed without posting.
dialogue.translation: Nakokɛnda kobandisa makambo na mokolo nyonso, kasi na bangomba mosusu nazali kozonga feed na ngai mpo na koboya te.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow many people?
dialogue.translation: Ozali kozonga bato mingi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but I mostly follow friends and family. I don't like getting too many likes or comments, so I keep my profile private.
dialogue.translation: Eh, kasi nazali kozonga baninga mpe libota malamu. Nayebi kobɛla nayebi to komɛntɛrɛ mingi te, mpo na yango nazali kosala profili na ngai ya ntaba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's smart. I have a public profile because I want more people to see my posts.
dialogue.translation: Ezali ya makasi. Nazali na profili ya komonko mpo nakokɛnda bato mingi kobɛla boya na ngai.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. But being online all the time can be exhausting, so I limit my time.
dialogue.translation: Nakokoma. Kasi kozala na likolo na ntango nyonso ekoki kozala ya mabe, mpo na yango nazali kobimisa ntango na ngai.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Maybe I should do that too.
dialogue.translation: Ozali na bosembo. Mbala mosusu nazali kobima yango mpe.

scenario: Giving a short presentation at work

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Next, I'll talk about our main challenges during that period.
dialogue.translation: Na kotié, nakokoma kozonga bangogo ya zomi na biso na ntango wana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Will you also mention the new marketing strategy?
dialogue.translation: Kasi okokoma kozonga stratéjie ya sika mosúsu?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, that's an important point, and I'll end with our goals for this month.
dialogue.translation: Eh, ezali mwa bangogo ya ntina, mpe nakosala na bangogo na biso ya sika oyo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow any sport? I'm really into football.
dialogue.translation: Ozali kozonga molakisi moko? Nazali na boye malamu na mbola.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I watch basketball. My favorite team is the Lakers, although they don't win every match.
dialogue.translation: Eh, nazali kozwa basketa. Bango nazali kobima ezali Lakers, kasi bazali koboya mbɔ́go nionso.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: They played against the Celtics last night, right? Who scored the most points?
dialogue.translation: Bazwaki kɔ́mɔ Celtics liboso ya mbɛ́, nde? Nani akɔtaki makasi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yeah, but we lost. Their best player had an amazing game.
dialogue.translation: Eh, kasi tolongolaki. Mokɔlɔ́ mpe ya bango alakisaki mbɔ́go ya malamu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a shame. Do you think they have a chance in the playoffs this season?
dialogue.translation: Ezali mabé. Oyebi ete bazali na bosɛ́li na playoff na mokolo oyo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe, but it's hard. Although they have good players, they need to improve their defense.
dialogue.translation: Mbala moko, kasi ezali makasi. Kasi bazali na bato ya malamu, bazali na bosɛ́li ya kobongisa lisusu ndakisa na bango.
